item.title: Every week without fail, 31st October
item.description:
Persistent littering and overflowing rubbish bins There is a persistent problem with rubbish and litter being left around the communal bins in the street. Bin bags are regularly ripped open, with waste spilling out and spreading across the pavement. As shown in the attached photographs, rubbish, food waste, plastic bags and other discarded items are scattered across the pavement and surrounding area. The bins are overflowing, and the problem appears to be ongoing rather than a one-off incident. This creates an unpleasant and unhygienic environment for residents and pedestrians. It also obstructs the pavement and can attract vermin. Please investigate this ongoing issue and arrange for the area to be cleared. I would also ask the council to review the frequency of rubbish collection and consider measures to prevent bin bags from being ripped open and rubbish from repeatedly accumulating in this location. This is a recurring problem that requires a lasting solution, rather than occasional clean-ups.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Woodland Grove, Greenwich
Report on FixMyStreet
